name: Passing of Judgment
description:
After the next time the opponent plays an Event Card this Round: Grant Invalidation to all Event Cards in the opponent's Hand.
After the opponent Discards from their Hand in this Round: Place the 2 cards with the highest Current Elemental Dice Cost from the opponent's Hand to the bottom of their deck.
(Only one Arcane Legend card can be played per match. This card will be in your starting hand.)
